ntp_servers.description: List of NTP server hostnames or IPs to synchronize with. Use public pools or your own infrastructure.

items.description: A single NTP server address (hostname or IP).

restrict_subnets.description: List of IP subnets (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24') allowed to query this NTP server. Leave empty to allow all clients (not recommended for public-facing servers).

items.description: A subnet or host IP in CIDR or dotted-decimal notation.

handle_leap_seconds.description: Whether to enable leap second handling using the IANA leap-seconds file.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (none) to 4 (debug). Value 3 is recommended for production to capture warnings and errors.

max_offset.description: Maximum absolute time offset (in seconds) allowed before OpenNTPD refuses to sync (prevents large time jumps). Set higher for unstable networks.
